title: LStepBetaEtaRow
html:
定义组：指标替换与规约。有序参数：z1035、z1036、z1037。

指定策略的一步规约；非规约传递闭包。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ LStepBetaEtaRow z1035 z1036 z1037) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists t
  (exists u
    (and
      (@ Pair t u z1037)
      (and
        (@ AnyRaw t)
        (and
          (@ AnyRaw u)
          (or
            (exists z1040
              (exists z1041
                (exists z1043
                  (exists z1044
                    (and
                      (@ Num0 z1040)
                      (and
                        (@ TApp z1041 z1044 t)
                        (and (or (@ ULam z1043 z1041) (exists z1042 (@ TLam z1042 z1043 z1041))) (@ LInst z1040 z1044 z1043 u))))))))
            (or
              (exists z1045
                (exists z1046
                  (exists z1047
                    (and
                      (@ TApp z1045 z1046 t)
                      (and
                        (@ TApp z1047 z1046 u)
                        (exists z1051
                          (exists z1052 (and (in z1051 z1036) (and (@ App z1035 z1051 z1052) (@ Pair z1045 z1047 z1052))))))))))
              (or
                (exists z1045
                  (exists z1046
                    (exists z1048
                      (and
                        (@ TApp z1045 z1046 t)
                        (and
                          (@ TApp z1045 z1048 u)
                          (exists z1053
                            (exists z1054 (and (in z1053 z1036) (and (@ App z1035 z1053 z1054) (@ Pair z1046 z1048 z1054))))))))))
                (or
                  (exists z1043
                    (exists z1049
                      (and
                        (@ ULam z1043 t)
                        (and
                          (@ ULam z1049 u)
                          (exists z1055
                            (exists z1056 (and (in z1055 z1036) (and (@ App z1035 z1055 z1056) (@ Pair z1043 z1049 z1056)))))))))
                  (or
                    (exists z1042
                      (exists z1043
                        (exists z1049
                          (and
                            (@ TLam z1042 z1043 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TLam z1042 z1049 u)
                            (exists z1057
                            (exists z1058 (and (in z1057 z1036) (and (@ App z1035 z1057 z1058) (@ Pair z1043 z1049 z1058))))))))))
                    (exists z1040
                      (exists z1045
                        (exists z1043
                          (exists z1050
                            (and
                            (@ Num0 z1040)
                            (and
                            (@ TVar z1040 z1050)
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z1045 z1050 z1043)
                            (and
                            (or (@ ULam z1043 t) (exists z1042 (@ TLam z1042 z1043 t)))
                            (and (not (@ LOcc z1040 z1045)) (@ LDown z1040 z1045 u))))))))))))))))))))
